reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.description: How figures are shown to you.
reporting.lens: Changes how figures are displayed. Nothing you recorded changes.
reporting.inflationHint: Deflates gain into purchasing-power terms. Nominal gain is always shown.

saved.reporting: Now reporting in {{currency}}. Nothing you recorded has changed.

structure.archived: {{name}} archived. You can restore it from the archived view.
structure.archiveFailed: Archiving didn't go through. Try again.
structure.restoreFailed: Restoring didn't go through. Try again.

archiveDialog.title: Archive {{name}}?
archiveDialog.description: Archived records disappear from lists and pickers, but nothing is deleted: every movement and all history survive, and you can restore it at any time.

empty.title: No institutions yet
empty.description: Register the banks, brokerages, exchanges, and wallets that hold your accounts — accounts come next.

form.createDescription: A bank, brokerage, exchange, pension provider — or a wallet you custody yourself.
form.editDescription: Change how this institution is recorded. Its accounts stay attached.
form.name: Name
form.kindsHint: Everything this institution is to you. Pick all that apply.
form.selfCustodyHint: A crypto wallet you control yourself. Its accounts don't need an institution behind them.

errors.name: Give it a name.
errors.url: Enter a full URL, like https://example.com.

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Create the accounts you hold — a brokerage account, a TFSA, a wallet — and record movements against them.

form.createDescription: An account lives in a country, carries a registration valid there, and keeps its books in one base currency.
form.editDescription: Change how this account is recorded. Its movements stay untouched.
form.name: Name
form.institutionHint: A self-custody wallet's account needs no institution behind it.
form.accountAdvantageNote: In the US and Canada, the tax advantage attaches to the account itself. BullLedger records this as information — it never computes tax owed.
form.contributionRoomHint: Optional. Your available room, as information only — checked against the yearly limits, never enforced.
form.instrumentAdvantageNote: In Brazil, tax advantages attach to the instrument (LCI, LCA, Poupança), not the account — you set those when registering an asset.
form.prevNote: Previdência is a hybrid: this {{plan}} account carries its own tax terms, and the funds you hold inside it are registered as assets.
form.deductibleHint: PGBL contributions can be deducted from taxable income; VGBL's cannot.

empty.title: No assets yet
empty.description: Register the instruments you hold — stocks, bonds, funds, savings, crypto — and record movements against them.

noMatches.title: Nothing of this type
noMatches.description: No assets match the selected type.

form.createDescription: Pick what kind of instrument this is; the fields that apply to it follow.
form.editDescription: Change how this asset is recorded. Its movements stay untouched.
form.archetypeLocked: An asset's type can't change — a different type is a different asset.

archetypeHint.CASH_DEPOSIT: Savings, deposit, or cash account balances that accrue.
archetypeHint.FIXED_INCOME: CDBs, LCIs, treasuries, bonds — paper with a maturity.
archetypeHint.EXCHANGE_SECURITY: Stocks, ETFs, REITs, FIIs — anything with a ticker.
archetypeHint.CRYPTO: Coins and tokens, exchange-held or self-custodied.

form.name: Name
form.currencyHint: The currency this asset is priced and recorded in.
form.rateValueHint: Optional. What the instrument yields — 13.75 for 13.75%, or the percentage of the index above.
form.couponRateHint: What it pays out periodically. Zero when it pays nothing until maturity.
form.issuerHint: A certificate must name one of your institutions as its issuer.
form.noIssuer: None — not one of your institutions
form.taxAdvantagedHint: Brazilian instrument-level exemptions — LCI, LCA, Poupança. Recorded as information only.
form.redemptionPeriodHint: As the fund states it, e.g. D+30.
form.decimalsHint: How many decimal places quantities carry — 18 for most coins.
form.wrapperNote: Looking for your 401(k), IRA, RRSP, TFSA, or FHSA? Tax wrappers are account registrations, never assets — set them when creating an account.

errors.name: Give it a name.
errors.issuerRequired: Pick the issuing institution — a certificate needs one.

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.description: The ledger is where everything else comes from. Record what happened and the figures follow.

noMatches.title: No movements match these filters
noMatches.description: Widen the dates, or clear the filters to see the whole ledger.

form.createDescription: What happened, where, and when. BullLedger records it; it never places it.
form.correctDescription: The original is voided and this correction is recorded in its place.
form.noAsset: No asset — the account's own cash
form.assetHint: Leave this empty for a deposit, withdrawal, fee, or tax on the account itself.
form.occurredOnHint: The real-world date of the event, which is not necessarily today. Back-dating is normal.
form.amountFeesIncluded: Exactly what left or entered the account, fees included.
form.quantityOptional: Optional — a lump-principal certificate has no units.
form.feeHint: The part of the amount above that was a fee. It rides on this trade rather than being its own movement.
form.fxRateHint: Leave blank to use the rate of the day. Anything you type is recorded exactly as typed.
form.fxSameCurrency: Same currency as the account, so the rate is 1.
form.lotHint: Which contribution this exit comes out of.
form.lotEmpty: This holding has no open contribution to draw from.
form.identityMismatch: {{quantity}} × {{price}} is {{gross}}, which is not what this amount works out to. Worth a second look — it may still be right.

errors.account: Choose the account this happened in.
errors.date: Enter the date it happened, as YYYY-MM-DD.
errors.amount: Enter an amount, with at most two decimal places.
errors.fee: Enter a fee, with at most two decimal places.
errors.lot: Choose which contribution this comes out of.

correct.banner: Recording this correction voids the original movement and writes a new one linked to it. Nothing is erased — the original stays readable under "Show voided".
correct.readOnlyVoided: This movement was voided on {{date}}. Voided movements are kept as history and cannot be corrected.
correct.readOnlyTransferLeg: This is one leg of a transfer, and a leg cannot be corrected on its own. Void the transfer and record it again.

void.title: Void this movement?
void.description: It stops counting toward every balance, position, and gain. The record itself is kept, and stays readable under "Show voided".
void.transferDescription: This is one leg of a transfer, so both legs are voided together. Both records are kept.
void.failed: The movement could not be voided.

transferForm.title: Record a transfer
transferForm.description: Value moving between two of your own accounts.
transferForm.basisNote: A transfer is not a sale. It carries its cost basis across, and produces no gain or loss.

errors.destination: Choose the account it went to.

lotsScreen.title: Lots
lotsScreen.description: How each contribution to a holding has performed, and what is left of it.
lotsScreen.selectHolding: Choose an account and an asset to see how its contributions were grouped.
lotsScreen.readOnly: Read-only. Lots are opened by what you record, not edited here.
lotsScreen.empty: This holding has no lots yet.

ledger.loadFailed: The ledger could not be loaded.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: This screen didn't load. Trying again may be all it takes.
